definitions.explanation: The period when something is at its most flourishing, intense, or active state. Used for seasons, popularity, careers, or physical condition.
The breeding season or mating period for animals, especially cats and dogs.

examples.english: The cherry blossoms are now at their peak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{盛|ざか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is at the prime working age.
examples.notes: [Note: 働き盛り is a compound meaning 'prime working years']

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{盛|さか}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて、⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
examples.english: The cat is in heat and meows every night.
examples.notes: [Note: 盛りがつく means 'to go into heat']

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|さか}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
examples.english: It is the height of summer and hot every day.
In spring, cats make mating calls.

examples.japanese: {盛|さか}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ついた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逃|に}げ{出|だ}した→逃げ出す：06041_nigedasu⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Most commonly appears in compound forms:
- 〜{盛|ざか}り (⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{盛|ざか}り - prime working age, ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{盛|ざか}り - age when one eats a lot)
- {盛|さか}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to be past one's prime)
- {盛|さか}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to go into heat)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦今→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧盛り⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (to be at the peak now)
- 盛り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (at the height of...)

WRITING: Usually written with kanji 盛り. The reading changes to ざかり in compounds.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最盛期|さいせいき}→最盛期：13058_saiseiki⟧ (peak period - more formal)
- ⟦{全盛|ぜんせい}→全盛：17145_zensei⟧ (heyday, golden age)
- ⟦{絶頂|ぜっちょう}→絶頂：13844_zecchou⟧ (climax, peak)
